hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, computes quotes via a proprietary bonding curve (EulerSwap v1), takes input tokens into Euler vaults, withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully own swap accounting. Blocks direct concentrated liquidity additions and donations to prevent irrecoverable fund loss.
